title: Re: Abadabadooddon
html:
Quest Giver: Ol' Chuck Pail

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Kill Abadabadooddon and 10 Abba Labbas in Storeroom 3A: Cankles, Webbed Toes, and Knobby Knees. Afterward, return to Ol' Chuck Pail in The Embercore Portal.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Ol' Chuck Pail

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: The Embercore Path

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Kill Abadabadooddon and 10 Abba Labbas in Storeroom 3A: Cankles, Webbed Toes, and Knobby Knees. Afterward, return to Ol' Chuck Pail in The Embercore Portal.

Offer:

Way to go! Rumors are circulating that you were the one who finally brought Abadabadooddon to justice after all these years. Although, rumor also has it that he has respawned and has been saying that he never heard of a Dungeon Runner by your name. Oh man, do I love me some juicy gossip!

But, as much as I love rumors, I can't stand it when they involve those infernal Abaddonians! Get in there and shut up Abadabadooddon to keep the rumor mill from pumping out any more of his nonsense. With his rumors quashed, I can finally get to more important gossip like who is Karl dating these days, or what class is Stephen going to nerf next. When you have taken care of Abadabadooddon and some Abba Labbas, return to me, Ol' Chuck Pail, here in The Embercore Portal.

Turn-in:

Did you shut up that goof, Abadabadooddon? Excellent! Let me know if you want to shut him up again.

Objectives:

  • Kill Abadabadooddon
  • Kill Abba Labbas

Level range: 41–46
